The '''Tas Sea''' was a turbulent sea that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. The [[Black Sun Fortress|fortress]] of [[Alexi Garyn]], the leader of the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], was built on top of a [[Granite/Legends|granite]] outcropping located within the Tas Sea.<ref name="CatCW" />
